project: Kumiki UI / ArtCraft source-led European hare

sources.title: European hare profile (Bavarian wildlife information portal)
sources.creator: Rudolf Vornehm (site photograph credit)
sources.rights: Reference only; reuse/license not verified; no image packaged
sources.visual_resolution: Web image search 512px thumbnail; proportions approximate, not a measured high-resolution crop

analysis.construction: Actual lateral brow, nostril, skull to throat and ear root; eye is set in a bulging orbital ring
analysis.material: Short near-direction hairs change orientation around socket, longer stiffer guard hairs on cheek and neck
analysis.microdetail: Whisker roots cluster on the maxillary pad; ear interior shows layered cartilage folds
analysis.light: Warm eye and muzzle facing soft side light; neck shadow separates cheek from shoulder

crops.observation: Single amber eye embedded in upper dark socket, dark upper lid, pale lower fold; not a simple outlined almond
crops.implementation_rule: Layer orbital-structure, eye-brow-bone, the existing amber/pupil/wax iris and eye-tear-duct

crops.observation: The nasal bridge narrows toward a small dark nostril; whisker pad and lower jaw are distinct connected masses
crops.implementation_rule: Nasal bridge + tapered muzzle projection + muzzle underside + inset whisker follicles

crops.observation: Ear wall has a recessed darker interior and thick outer rim, connected to skull base
crops.implementation_rule: Outer lip, canal-shadow, inner fold path and near-ear animated parenting

sources.title: Portrait of a Hare in Oil Pastel
sources.creator: Nadezhda Kokorina
sources.rights: Copyright reserved; visual study only, do not copy artwork or distribute source images
sources.medium: oil pastel on paper (not identical to hard wax crayon)

analysis.construction: Face and neck read as contiguous volume with no large circular cheek sticker
analysis.material: Overlapping short/long light and dark gestures follow eye corner, neck and ear
analysis.microdetail: Multihued fur root, narrow amber eye and highly selective white edge filaments
analysis.light: Dark background, strong value hierarchy around eye

crops.observation: Fur is built from connected directional color bands, not distributed uniform sparse flecks
crops.implementation_rule: Use separate attached orbital, zygomatic, nasal and jowl planes before fur flow; keep highest contrast near eye

sources.title: After the Dawn (hare)
sources.creator: Tracy Barnett
sources.rights: Copyright reserved; style observation only, no artwork imported
sources.medium: colored pencil; anatomical detail reference, not a wax-material claim

analysis.construction: Nasal bridge and jaw have subtle curvature with taper toward nostril
analysis.material: Tightly packed directional hairs change scale from brow to chest
analysis.microdetail: A few visible long whiskers sit over dense small root hairs; eye highlight restrained
analysis.light: Warm nasal bridge vs cool lower fur

sources.title: Richard Hull crayon work and sgraffito
sources.creator: Richard Hull
sources.rights: Artist copyright reserved; technical observation only

analysis.construction: Dense intertwined, continuous forms hold painted mass
analysis.material: Wax buildup is scratched back exposing lower pigment
analysis.microdetail: Directional comb-like scratches and contrasting underpainting

feature_targets.geometry_rule: One asymmetric wedge-shaped skull with cheek/jaw attachment, not a circle or egg
feature_targets.source_observation: Brow bridges forward into nasal slope; cheek narrows into throat

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Dark ring and separate brow/tear duct around an amber iris and opaque held blinking
feature_targets.source_observation: Small glossy eye set below robust brow with inner corner

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Connected tapering bridge, unequal muzzle pads and inset nose/philtrum
feature_targets.source_observation: Not a round peanut or separate nose ball; clustered vibrissal pores at upper pad

feature_targets.geometry_rule: Two differently bent ear surfaces with nested rim/lip/canal shadow, attached to head pivot
feature_targets.source_observation: Asymmetric near/far ear and dark, recessed cartilage roots

negative_controls: Oval skull filled with one warm color and dark outline
Circular eye sticker with isolated white point but no orbit or tear corner
Peanut-shaped muzzle with black dot nose and no maxillary pad
Two identical tapered ear triangles without attached canal and folded lip
Global random noise or uniform-angle hatching used instead of anatomical pigment boundaries
evidence_state: Source works inspected through web image search, no locally stored reference crops. ArtCraft strict v6 pixel/axis release gate remains BLOCKED; do not label source-faithful.
